name: schema-shape-check-for-cast-wire-reads
description: When a component reads a run wire field through an inline TS cast (as {field?:...}), cross-check the key against the generated client schema (lib/packages/fabro-api-client/src/models/<Type>.ts) before trusting it: run-verdict.tsx read lifecycle.conclusionFailure, a ghost field the RunLifecycle schema never carried (schema: lifecycle.error.message), so the recorded park reason silently never rendered and the null-fixture test could not catch it.
